name: checklist-design
description: Review UI and UX against Checklist Design's bundled checklists, with systematic audit and quick critique modes.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and critique UI with 125 bundled design checklists
interface.longDescription: Review websites, web apps, mobile apps, user flows, and design-system components against Checklist Design's bundled checklists. Use audit mode for item-by-item coverage checks or critique mode for concise design feedback.
defaultPrompt: Audit this UI against the most relevant Checklist Design checklist.
Critique this screen's hierarchy, layout, typography, accessibility, and polish.
Check what's missing from this flow before I ship it.
